name: hero_confuse_no_play
description: Confused hero with no playable hand: all cards cost more than the pool, so the auto-stage stages nothing and the fixed hook runs the no-play path at once instead of idling on the hold forever (the hold-beat bug: an unconditional hold-beat would re-stage nothing every frame and never execute). No CARD_PLAYED fires, the battle continues, and the poison still ticks down (STATUS_EXPIRED proves rounds advance).
